title: Inspiration of Scripture
definition: The inspiration of Scripture means that God breathed out His Word through human authors so that Scripture is truly God's Word while written through real human writers in history.
summary: Scripture is not merely human religious insight. God superintended its writing so that His message is trustworthy, authoritative, and profitable.
christFocus: Christ affirmed the reliability of Scripture and is the One to whom the inspired Word bears witness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Inspiration of Scripture teaches that God's people must receive this truth under the authority of the Lord, allowing Scripture itself to define the doctrine rather than personal opinion, tradition, or culture.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it protects the believer from confusion and helps the church remain anchored in what God has actually spoken. Without this truth, faith can drift toward feelings, assumptions, or human wisdom.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: A disciple should respond to inspiration of scripture by reading the Word prayerfully, testing beliefs by Scripture, obeying what God reveals, and helping others handle the Bible with humility, clarity, and faith.

studySections.heading: Guardrails and Common Errors
studySections.content: This doctrine should not be used to win arguments while neglecting love, nor should it be separated from prayer, obedience, and dependence on the Holy Spirit. The goal is faithful submission to God, not mere possession of information.

sources: Scripture references listed in this doctrine entry.
